symptom: feature readers failed the replica gate on first run (calibration failures, wrong-series reads, misses)
root_cause: (a) inward tick stubs matched black series; (b) antialiased edges of one series leaked into a similar-colour mask; (c) JPEG 4:2:0 desaturates thin coloured lines (declared 200,30,30 renders 176,63,64); (d) per-column run choice jumped between series; tracking slope from two integer rows lost series after gaps; (e) graded same-hue palettes: dark-line edges look like the lighter series; (f) loop branch read from a lone run; crossing groups fragmented; (g) butterfly branches swap at E=0; (h) stacked markers on steep segments; (i) OCR 'O.2'; (j) declared ticks matched to the first N detected majors (spurious ticks) and a 25 px residual inflated u
fix: readers.py: tick-stub blanking; luma/chroma/hue blend mask with core-pixel components; graded-palette cleanup; continuity tracking (fitted slope, gap tolerance); two-branch reads (exactly two runs, else tracked pair, else None); crossing grouping 6 px and exactly-two rule; marker run merge (merge_gap); O->0 in numeric labels; best contiguous tick match and calibration rejected when residual > 1.5 px
regression: replica gate 31/34 style x feature cells PASS (replicas/feature_check.json)

symptom: Bragg agreement recovery (HRTEM FFT spacing, SAED ring radii, scale-bar calibration) yields no bindable opportunity
root_cause: lattice.py replica gate 6/7 styles PASS (hrtem_s039g FAIL: one bar end blurred into a parallel fringe crest, 92% within 2u). Real panels: S039 F4j/F4k SAED refused - beam spot axis ratio 1.25/1.27 (figure scaled anisotropically; rings at ~0.6x the radii implied by the bar for spinel); S039 F4h measured d = 0.418 +- 0.006 nm but its (111) peak (2theta ~18 deg) is outside the XRD scan (20-70 deg) and the frozen Bragg law compares the same hkl; S039 F4g not measured (style FAIL); T042 F3a dominant fringe 0.766 nm, the labelled (222)/(220) spacings (0.11-0.14 nm) are 1.4-1.7 px at 12.8 px/nm (unresolvable), insets have no own scale bar; T042 F3b bar not found (dropped); T042 XRD route absent (F2b)
class: paper quirk (figure production) + rule gap avoided (no cubic d(hkl) conversion added to the frozen law)
fix: none: no rebinding; shortfall kept. Anisotropy refusal added before any real measurement was made, validated on replicas (stretched 1.1-1.3x: 12/12 refused; round: 0 false refusals). It was motivated by the visual QA of the F4j bar box (a restriction, not a tuning)
regression: freeze F5 PASS; T3 ready stays 14
